About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 90 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

About the Role

We are looking for an analytical, organised and proactive Fiat & Payments Business Manager to support fiat governance and the management and development of our global and European fiat, card and payments businesses, including business activities within regulated entities. This role combines business management, project coordination, performance analysis, market research and general business risk control, working across teams to turn business priorities into clear plans and measurable outcomes.
You will help keep key initiatives on track, provide actionable insights and support effective governance across the business. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role focused on coordination, analysis and delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Support the day-to-day management and development of the fiat and payments business, with a focus on the following areas:
  • Fiat governance and business coordination: Support governance and business management across global and European operations, including regulated entities. Prepare meeting materials, maintain decision and action logs, and follow up on agreed actions. Coordinate with relevant control functions to ensure initiatives follow applicable entity-level requirements and established review and approval processes, respecting local accountability and decision-making authority. Support general business risk control by identifying and tracking operational, financial and delivery risks, coordinating mitigation actions, monitoring adherence to agreed controls and escalating issues promptly. Work alongside Risk, Compliance, Legal and Finance, without replacing their specialist responsibilities or independent oversight.
  • Key project management: Coordinate priority initiatives across fiat, cards and payments. Maintain project plans, milestones, owners and dependencies; monitor progress; and escalate risks or blockers with practical recommendations.
  • Data analysis and business insights: Analyse business performance, customer behaviour, revenue, costs and product adoption. Translate findings into clear insights that support prioritisation, commercial decisions and performance improvements.
  • Market and competitor research: Monitor developments in crypto, fiat payments and card products. Assess competitor propositions, customer needs and emerging opportunities, and summarise their implications for the business.
  • Business and product development support: Help assess new initiatives, prepare business cases and coordinate launch readiness and post-launch reviews with Product, Operations, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Legal and other stakeholders.
  • Reporting and communication: Produce regular business reports and concise management updates covering performance, project status, key risks and decisions required. Maintain accurate and well-organised supporting documentation.
  • Cross-functional delivery: Bring together stakeholders across business lines and departments, clarify responsibilities and follow through on commitments to support timely delivery.

What We Are Looking For

You bring strong analytical and organisational skills, sound judgement and a genuine interest in building your career in fiat, payments and digital assets.
  • A bachelor’s degree or higher, with at least one year of relevant professional experience; two years or more is preferred. Basic understanding of crypto, fiat payments, cards or related financial services, with a strong interest in developing expertise in these areas.
  • Strong data analysis skills, including the ability to interpret financial and operational metrics and communicate clear, actionable conclusions.
  • Project management and organisational capability, with a structured approach to prioritisation, progress tracking and follow-through.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to prepare concise reports and presentations for different audiences.
  • Ability to collaborate across departments and business lines, align stakeholders and coordinate projects without relying on direct authority.
  • A results-oriented mindset, attention to detail and ownership of the quality and timeliness of deliverables.
  • Resilience under pressure and comfort working with ambiguity, changing priorities and a fast-moving business environment.
  • Sound risk awareness and judgement, including knowing when to raise concerns or involve the appropriate specialists.
  • A fast learner with a proactive, curious approach, able to quickly understand new products, business models and industry developments and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken, is essential. Availability to work during European business hours is required.

Preferred Qualifications

The following would be an advantage, but are not essential:
  • Relevant working experience in crypto, fintech, fiat payments, card businesses or related financial services.
  • Relevant academic and/or professional background in economics, treasury, data analytics, finance or a related discipline, with strong numerical skills and confidence working with data.
  • Experience with analytical tools such as advanced Excel, SQL or business intelligence platforms.
  • Experience working in an international company, with a track record of effective cross-departmental communication and coordination across teams, markets or time zones. Comfortable navigating complex, multi-stakeholder workflows, managing dependencies and working through multiple review and approval stages. Experience supporting cross-functional projects, business reporting or governance processes is an advantage.
  • Mandarin or a European language, such as German, French, Spanish, Portuguese or Italian.
Why Join Us
 
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. Our benefits include:
  • Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
  • Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
  • Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
  • Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
  • Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.
